description_en: Checks whether the specified resource of Key Management Service (KMS) is associated with an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询KMS的指定资源是否关联了RDS实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-kms-associate-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --kms-resource-user 1788966360000000 --kms-resource-type key --kms-resource-id a62f7800-6500-4f00-a000-3ca4def80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeKmsAssociateResources

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the KMS resource belongs
parameters.name: kms_resource_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the KMS resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: KMS资源所属的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: kms_resource_user

parameters.help_en: The type of the KMS resource. Only key is supported
parameters.help_zh: KMS资源类型，当前仅支持key（密钥）
parameters.name: kms_resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the KMS resource. Only key IDs are supported
parameters.name: kms_resource_id

AssociateDBInstances.description_en: The information about the associated ApsaraDB RDS instances

Engine.description_en:
The database engine. Valid values:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
Engine.description_zh:
数据库引擎，返回值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL

KeyUsedBy.description_en:
The purpose of the key. Valid values:

DiskEncryption: cloud disk encryption
TDE: transparent data encryption
KeyUsedBy.description_zh:
密钥使用途径，返回值：

DiskEncryption：云盘加密
TDE：透明数据加密

Status.description_en:
The state of the instance. Valid values:

CREATING: The instance is being created.
ACTIVATION: The instance is running.
DELETING: The instance is being deleted.
RESTARTING: The instance is being restarted.
INS_MAINTAINING: The configuration of the instance is being changed.
INS_MAINTAINING: The instance is being maintained.
BACKUP_RECOVERING: The instance is being restored.
NET_MODIFYING: The network type of the instance is being changed
Status.description_zh:
实例状态，返回值：

CREATING：实例创建中
ACTIVATION：实例运行中
DELETING：实例删除中
RESTARTING：实例重启中
CLASS_CHANGING：规格变配中
INS_MAINTAINING：实例维护中
BACKUP_RECOVERING：备份恢复中
NET_MODIFYING：网络变更中

AssociateStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether an associated RDS instance exists.

true: Yes
false: No
AssociateStatus.description_zh:
是否存在关联的RDS实例。

true：是。
false：否
